Description: Quotes related to cleaning, hygiene, and home maintenance

Quotes.Text: Have nothing in your houses that you do not know to be useful or believe to be beautiful.
Quotes.Author: William Morris

Quotes.Text: Cleaning your house while your kids are still growing is like shoveling the walk before it stops snowing.
Quotes.Author: Phyllis Diller

Quotes.Text: The objective of cleaning is not just to clean, but to feel happiness living within that environment.
Quotes.Author: Marie Kondo

Quotes.Text: A clean home is a happy home.
Quotes.Author: Traditional Proverb

Quotes.Text: Order is the shape upon which beauty depends.
Quotes.Author: Pearl S. Buck

Quotes.Text: The home should be the treasure chest of living.
Quotes.Author: Le Corbusier

Quotes.Text: Outer order contributes to inner calm.
Quotes.Author: Gretchen Rubin

Quotes.Text: A place for everything, and everything in its place.
Quotes.Author: Samuel Smiles

Quotes.Text: Your home is living space, not storage space.
Quotes.Author: Francine Jay
